title: Wrong-Item Refunds on Approved Replacements — Cartwise Grocery Orders Desk Rule and Booking Tool
content:
## Scope

This desk rule covers **Cartwise Grocery Orders** item lines on which the customer approved a substitution while the order was being shopped, and on which the product handed over turned out to be a different product from the replacement the customer approved.

## The rule

> When the order entries show that the replacement handed over on a line whose substitution the customer approved is a different product from the approved replacement, the customer keeps the product handed over and the line is refunded with refund reason `wrong_item` at the wrong-item refund this rule computes, not at the line's full charge.

Put as condition and result:

| Condition shown by the order entries | Result |
|---|---|
| The line's substitution decision is approved by the customer, and the product handed over differs from the approved replacement | The customer keeps the product; the line is refunded with reason `wrong_item` at the wrong-item refund |

The product handed over is never collected back. The amount booked is the wrong-item refund, not the full charge of the line.

## Booking tool: `refund_wrong_item_79d6dec9`

**Capability.** The tool books a refund on one billed item line of a Cartwise Grocery Orders order for a product that was handed over in place of the one the customer had approved. One call adds one item-refund entry to the order, naming the order line and the billed line entry it pays back, carrying the controlled refund reason and the refunded amount. The money goes to the customer's original payment method and the net amount billed on the order falls by that amount. The entry shows at once among the order's entries with today's date.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, passing the parameters below.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | Customer reference number of the person who placed the order, as read from the customer profile lookup | Id |
| `order_id` | Order number of the grocery order being refunded, as read from the order lookup | Id |
| `line_number` | Position of the refunded item line on the order, exactly as shown on the billed line entry | Integer (1, 2, 3 ...), no decimals |
| `source_event_id` | Reference number of the billed item line entry (the line charge) that this refund pays back, as read from the order entries lookup | Id |
| `refund_reason` | Controlled reason recorded on the refund | One literal of the list below |
| `amount_usd` | Amount refunded on the line | USD, positive, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed; never 0 or negative |

The `refund_reason` literals the tool accepts are: `missing` (the billed product never reached the customer), `damaged` (arrived broken, crushed or leaking), `wrong_item` (a different product from the one ordered or approved was handed over), `quality` (arrived spoiled, expired or otherwise unfit), `substitution_rejected` (the customer turned down a delivered replacement), `substitution_price_protection` (the replacement was billed above the protected price of the original), `weight_overage` (a product sold by weight was billed above the allowed weight), `alcohol_id_failed` (alcohol lines taken back after a failed ID check at handoff), `returned_order` (the whole order went back to the store undelivered), `late_delivery` (a fee returned because the order completed late; fee refunds only) and `item_refund_share` (the service fee share returned with item refunds; fee refunds only).

**Return.** A receipt with `order_event_id` (reference number of the new refund entry), `order_id`, `line_number`, `refund_reason`, `refund_destination` (always `original_payment_method`), `amount_usd` (the amount booked, 2 decimal places) and `status`, which reads "booked" when the refund entry now stands on the order.

## Points of judgement

- **Which line?** The line whose substitution decision the customer approved and on which a different product was handed over.
- **Which reason?** `wrong_item`.
- **Which amount?** The wrong-item refund, which is not the line's full charge.
